selection: Entire existing allele cohort. Extra candidates: exact SNV, aggregate germline P/LP (no conflicts), review >=1 star, molecular consequence splice or UTR, gene-symbol overlap with preexisting model gene contexts. No model outcomes used.
limits: Missing VCF match is not benign.
Gene symbol overlap is availability screening, not a transcript coordinate/strand verification.
Clinical classification is not an RBP-binding or measured mutation effect label.
VCV accession intentionally unversioned; release-bound variation IDs supplied.
Inside existing 101nt intervals uses exact old variant centers +/-50; new off-center edits require REF-sequence validation before inference.
